> Please read first: this repository is research code released to support
> reproducibility of a paper, and receives light, best-effort maintenance only.
> Feature requests are welcome as discussion, but there is no commitment to
> implement them. Bug reports and bug-fix pull requests get priority.

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what makes it hard today?

## Proposed Solution

What you would like to see happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you have thought about or tried.

## Scope

- Does this affect the core mapping pipeline, or the scene-adaptation tooling?
- Would it change existing configs, topics or artifacts?

## Additional Context

Links, references, or examples from other projects.
